backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing e-commerce backend with product management, shopping cart, user profiles, branding/homepage configuration, shop details, Stripe integration, access control, and blob storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three implemented features: shape filter buttons in ProductManagementTable, shape filter state management, and bulk inline editing functionality with associated test IDs and component dependencies.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including components, pages, hooks, and utilities describing their functionality and recent updates.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes, defining colors for UI elements like backgrounds, borders, cards, and charts using oklch color space.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React application with viewport meta tag and script reference to main.tsx, titled 'Original Creations Hub'.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component configuring TanStack Router with routes for marketplace, dashboard, checkout, payment, legal pages, and basket; includes ThemeProvider, Toaster, and dynamic branding hook.
frontend/src/components/BrandingSettings: Admin component for configuring site branding including site name, logo, and favicon with file upload, preview, progress tracking, and integration with backend branding configuration API.
frontend/src/components/BulkProductUploa: Component for bulk uploading multiple products with image files, supporting auto-copy of fields across products, template-based descriptions, and progress tracking for each upload.
frontend/src/components/DescriptionTempl: Dialog component for creating and editing reusable product description templates with name and content fields.
Manager component that displays a list of description templates with options to create, edit, and delete templates.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying site information, legal links (terms/privacy), contact details from shop settings, and a caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/HomepageSettings: Admin settings component for customizing homepage hero section including motto text, promotional text, and hero image upload with preview.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout wrapper with sticky header navigation, logo/branding, authentication controls, cart icon with item count, mobile menu, and footer outlet for page content.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Displays a product card with image, name, shape, category, price, and an 'Add to Basket' button that uses the useAddToCart mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/ProductDetailVie: Modal dialog showing detailed product information with 'Add to Basket' and 'Buy Now' buttons; 'Buy Now' stores product ID in sessionStorage and navigates to checkout.
frontend/src/components/ProductManagemen: Admin table for managing products with inline editing, image upload with progress tracking, inventory adjustment controls, shape filtering, and bulk update operations with confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Disabled component that previously showed a profile setup modal after login; now returns null.
frontend/src/components/ShopDetailsSetti: Form for managing shop information including name, contact details, address, opening hours, and company details with validation and update mutation.
frontend/src/components/StripeSetup.tsx: Configuration interface for setting up Stripe payments with secret key input, allowed countries selection, and delete functionality with confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, initializing access control with admin token and invalidating dependent queries on actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useDynamicBranding.ts: Fetches branding configuration and dynamically updates document title and favicon based on the retrieved settings.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend operations including user profiles, products, cart management, Stripe configuration, branding, shop details, homepage config, and description templates.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a warm terracotta and earthy color palette for light and dark modes, plus Google Fonts imports for Crimson Pro and Inter.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client and Internet Identity provider, then renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/Checkout.tsx: Checkout page that displays cart items or buy-now products, calculates totals, and creates Stripe checkout sessions with success/cancel URL handling.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Admin dashboard with tabs for product management, bulk upload, Stripe setup, branding, shop details, homepage settings, and description templates, plus statistics cards showing inventory metrics.
frontend/src/pages/Marketplace.tsx: Public marketplace page with hero section, product filtering by search/shape/category, sorting options (most viewed, best selling, newest), and product detail modal view.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailure.tsx: Displays a payment failure page with an error icon, message, and buttons to retry checkout or return to the shop.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccess.tsx: Shows a payment success confirmation page, clears the cart and buyNowProductId from session storage on mount, and provides a button to continue shopping.
frontend/src/pages/PrivacyPolicy.tsx: Renders a static privacy policy page with sections covering information collection, usage, sharing, payment processing, security, user rights, cookies, children's privacy, and contact information.
frontend/src/pages/ShoppingBasket.tsx: Displays the shopping cart with product items, quantity controls, remove functionality, and a checkout summary with total price and proceed-to-checkout button.
frontend/src/pages/Terms.tsx: Renders a static terms and conditions page covering products, pricing, shipping, returns, intellectual property, liability, and contact information.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utility functions for extracting URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence and cleanup capabilities.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color scheme using OKLCH, typography, container settings, custom animations, and plugins for the application's design system.
project_state.json: Project state file tracking an Artisan Hub marketplace application with bulk image upload, AI-generated descriptions, Stripe payments, and product management features. Contains architectural notes, known issues (image persistence, marketplace loading, missing admin link), and a comprehensive list of implemented features across 47 versions.
